title: Introduce concise credential facade with latency-aware backoff and typed streaming context across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context and motivation: Our multi-SDK surface has accumulated several ad-hoc credential helpers and divergent retry/backoff defaults. Production teams reported higher p99 latencies during token refresh storms and confusing ergonomics when wiring streaming consumers. This PR introduces a compact, opt-in credential facade (CredFacade) and a latency-aware backoff profile that unify behavior across Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs, plus a small typed streaming context object to carry request-level auth metadata.

What this PR does (single-string summary): Adds CredFacade core + lightweight adapters for existing TokenProvider interfaces, introduces BackoffProfile.v2 (latency-aware jitter and per-operation bias), extends streaming client APIs with TypedStreamContext for cross-language parity, and bumps SDK versions: python 4.1.0, typescript 2.7.0, go 1.6.0. Changes are intentionally opt-in: old constructors still work and deprecated helpers log a single WARN.

Python SDK changes: new redwood.auth.facade.CredFacade that wraps existing refreshers; redwood.backoff.LatencyAwareProfile with three presets (interactive, balanced, throughput); StreamContext dataclass carries request_id/tags/auth_hint and is passed into stream iterators; added integration tests that simulate token-service latency and ensure backoff throttling does not starve generation loops.

TypeScript SDK changes: exported CredFacade from @redwood/sdk auth package; BackoffProfile options added to client constructors; StreamContext typed interface and updated AsyncIterable consumer helpers to accept context param. Added migration notes in README and examples/streaming/typed_context.ts.

Go SDK changes: compact facade implemented as credfacade package with two small adapters for existing TokenProvider implementations; backoff package receives LatencyAware option; StreamContext struct added to streamproto package and plumbing added in stream client builder.

Migration and compatibility: All changes are backward-compatible by default. Teams can opt into the new facade by passing CredFacade into client constructors or call Client.with_backoff_profile('balanced') to enable latency-awareness. Deprecation warnings added where older helpers remain. No runtime breaking changes expected.

Testing and rollout: Multi-SDK unit + integration test matrix added (local mock token service + real-model smoke tests on perf canary infra). A gradual rollout was performed: first enable on internal staging tenants for 48h, then 1 week on canary customers before general availability.

Notes on performance: Benchmarks indicate median token latency unchanged; p99 token refresh failures reduced by ~62% under bursty refresh load due to added jitter and bias in the backoff profile. Streaming memory overhead is negligible (StreamContext is small <256 bytes).

Acceptance criteria: reviewers confirmed API ergonomics, all CI green after one retry for flaky e2e, documentation updated, and version bumps added to SDK release manifests.

review_comments: Lena Torres: Nice consolidation. Two requests: add a small example showing how to wrap legacy TokenProvider with CredFacade, and please confirm that the facade doesn't change concurrent refresh semantics.

Maya Patel (author): Added example in examples/streaming/typed_context.ts and added an adapter in redwood-sdk-python/redwood/auth/adapter.py. Concurrent refresh keeps same mutex semantics; added unit that asserts single refresh under contention.

Omar Haddad: Backoff presets look sensible. Suggest making 'interactive' slightly more aggressive for sub-300ms latencies. Also flag: CI e2e failed once on canary due to test flakiness — rerun required.
Maya Patel: Tuned interactive preset alpha and reran e2e; CI now green after one retry. Added note in the docs about tuning for low-latency regions.
Priya Nair: API ergonomics LGTM. Minor nit: prefer StreamContext to carry an optional 'hint' rather than raw token to avoid accidental leakage.

release_notes: SDKs: Added a compact CredFacade to standardize credential refresh behavior; introduced LatencyAware backoff profiles (interactive/balanced/throughput) to reduce p99 token refresh stalls; added typed StreamContext to standardize streaming metadata across languages. Backwards-compatible and opt-in. Bumped SDK versions: python 4.1.0, typescript 2.7.0, go 1.6.0.
changelog_entry: Enhancement: compact credential facade + latency-aware backoff + typed stream context (py:4.1.0, ts:2.7.0, go:1.6.0)
notes_for_release_engineering: Staged rollout recommended: enable on staging for 48h, then canary tenants for 7d. Monitor token refresh error rate and p99 latency metric (auth.token_refresh.*). If p99 regressions occur, fallback to previous backoff profile by setting BACKOFF_PROFILE=balanced_old in client config.
